timing_basis: First to last runner-log timestamp, including setup and post steps, excluding queue time.
interval_method: 90% percentile intervals from 50,000 circular moving-block bootstrap resamples of paired per-commit means, block length 5 commits. Repetitions are averaged within each commit; they are not treated as independent source changes. Intervals describe the observed histories, not arbitrary future workloads.

cohort_join.overlap_review: At the overlapping commit, both cohorts restore the same cache source and cache keys apart from isolation prefixes, use the same compiler, run the same test count, and compile the same workspace crates. Archive sizes differ by less than 0.002% in both modes. Full-cache compilation averages 36.51 s and 36.53 s in the two cohorts. The later cohort therefore supplies the remaining history after this cache refresh.

unmeasured_failed_attempts.reason: Both seed jobs compiled all Rust targets, then failed three TestPyPI snapshots because the service changed its documentation URLs. Build the unmeasured initial seed with --no-run; retain the same source and cache keys, and execute complete measured jobs and later producers.

sample_selection.sample_description: For each source change, use one measured cache-producing pair when the uv PR planner enables saves and the cache key is not an exact hit; otherwise use the mean of three read-only pairs. Each source change has equal weight in the aggregate.
